बॉलीवुड के इस पावर कपल का प्यार और रिस्पेक्ट देखकर आप भी कहेंगे वाह! 🔥

CNN-News18 Indian of the Year 2026 अवॉर्ड्स इवेंट में आदित्य धर और यामी गौतम ने एक-दूसरे के बारे में कई खास बातें शेयर कीं। 📸

आदित्य धर ने अपनी पत्नी यामी को अपना Lady Luck बताते हुए कहा कि उन्हें Overnight Sensation बनने में पूरे 20 साल लग गए। 2006 में मुंबई आए आदित्य ने Uri: The Surgical Strike बनाकर नेशनल अवॉर्ड भी जीता। 🎬

इवेंट में यामी ने आदित्य के जुनून का जिक्र करते हुए बताया कि वह सेट पर बिना सोए करीब 70 घंटे तक लगातार काम करते हैं। वहीं आदित्य ने भी यामी को Golden Heart वाली इंसान बताते हुए Article 370 और Haq में उनकी बेहतरीन एक्टिंग की तारीफ की। ❤️

4 जून 2021 को शादी के बंधन में बंधे इस कपल ने मई 2024 में अपने बेटे Vedavid का स्वागत किया था।

ctx.title: Aditya Dhar calls Yami Gautam his ‘lady luck’: ‘Took me 20 years to become overnight sensation’
ctx.text:
Filmmaker Aditya Dhar and actor Yami Gautam spoke about each other’s contributions to their personal and professional lives at the CNN-News18 Indian of the Year 2026 awards. The couple, who were honoured at the event, spoke about their respective journeys in the film industry, with Aditya crediting Yami for bringing good fortune into his life, while she praised his integrity, determination and courage.
Talking about his journey in the film industry, Aditya said that his success had come after years of hard work and perseverance.
“I can only say that it took me 20 years to become an overnight sensation. So, it’s been quite a hell of a journey. And the graph has been quite an exciting one. I’m really, really thankful that I’m married to one of the most beautiful human beings I have ever met. My fate changed the moment she entered my life. And I feel that it’s all the lady luck which is helping me tell the Bharat story to the world,” he said.
Aditya moved to Mumbai in 2006 to pursue his filmmaking ambitions and spent several years working as an assistant director, lyricist and dialogue writer before making his mark as a director with Uri: The Surgical Strike (2019). The film, starring Vicky Kaushal, became a major commercial success and won Aditya the National Film Award for Best Direction. Dhurandhar brought him widespread recognition for his filmmaking, making his remarks about the two-decade-long journey particularly significant.
Yami also shared heartfelt words for her husband. When asked what makes Aditya stand out as a filmmaker and a person, she described him as a rare combination of integrity, honesty, character, passion and hard work.
Yami also spoke about how difficult experiences in the film industry can sometimes change people, making them bitter or negative. However, she said Aditya had managed to retain his kindness despite everything he had experienced.
Yami also highlighted Aditya’s extraordinary dedication to filmmaking, recalling how he would work on sets for nearly 70 hours without sleep, driven by a clear vision and the determination to give a project his everything. She said that pursuing such an ambitious vision also required ‘guts’ and the courage to see it through.

Aditya was equally generous with his praise for Yami. Calling her a woman with a “golden heart”, he said he believed audiences had “not seen even 50% of her potential.”
He also praised Yami’s versatility, saying that her performances in Article 370 and Haq were among her finest. Aditya added that he was excited about her upcoming projects and believed audiences would get to see some exceptional work from her in the near future.
When asked whether it was easy or difficult to direct his wife, Aditya explained that they have always maintained a professional approach towards work, even though they share a personal relationship.
He further explained that even when discussing a potential project, he prefers to follow the formal channels of communication rather than casually making an offer at home. “Because that actually is kind of the sanctity of our work, because for us, it’s almost like Saraswati. So, it has to be professional when it comes to work,” he said.
This is not the first time Yami and Aditya have spoken about the qualities they admire in each other. In a 2021 interview with Hindustan Times, shortly after their wedding, Yami had spoken about what drew her to Aditya. She said that while they did not necessarily need to share similar interests, having the same value system and ethics was important to her. She also said she had immense respect for him, both as a professional and as a person.
